notes.title: Inexistence Rebirth 3.0
notes.content:
The major update 3.0 of Inexistence Rebirth is now out! 
Changelog: 

- Improvement of fights to make them more dynamic and nervous
- Ability to attack enemies while crouching down
- Improved rear dodge
- Fixed some bugs related to gameplay, balancing, Level Design, etc...


Don't hesitate to send me your feedback, I'll stile continue to improve the game as much as I can! 

Thanks a lot!

notes.title: Inexistence Rebirth Update 2.0
notes.content:
Inexistence is updated to version 2.0, with a big major update! 

Bugs Fix : 
- Fixed texts that were displayed in bulk and prevented the use of the menus
- Correction of texts that were out of the IU
- Fixed bug that prevented the use of some keyboard inputs
- Improved "Hard Mode" by making enemies more powerful
- Improved stats of some enemies
- Minor bug fixes in UI.

If you find other bugs, don't hesitate to contact me, I propose updates very quickly, in a very reactive way!

notes.title: Inexistence Rebirth Patch 1.15
notes.content:
Hello,
A new version is available.
Here is the change log :

- Fixed issue what unallowed to use spear in Sister Mode to activate Switch
- Fixed issue what sometime you could take damage when you teleport
- Fixed French word mistakes issue
- Removed points stats for sister mode

Please, keep in mind that there are still some issues that I will fix as soon as possible, if you find a bug, don't hesitate to send me message, I'll do my best to fix that really quickly, to no bother your progression.

Thanks! :)
